reviews.title: Reliable, easy setup — just be mindful of the size
reviews.comment:
This WiFi adapter was incredibly easy to set up and worked right out of the box. It was true plug-and-play on our system, and it connected quickly with no extra steps.
Connection has been stable and consistent. No dropouts, no lag issues during normal use, and it handled everyday browsing and streaming without any problems.
The only thing to note is the physical size. It’s a bit larger than expected, especially with the dual antennas, so it can stick out depending on where your USB port is. If you’re using a front-facing port or a tight space, it may feel a little “in the way.”
That said, it’s stayed securely in place and hasn’t been accidentally bumped out, so the size is more of a setup/placement consideration than a functional issue.
Best for:
Desktops that need a quick WiFi upgrade
Plug-and-play users who don’t want to deal with drivers
Everyday use like browsing, streaming, and general tasks
Not ideal for:
Very tight or high-traffic USB port locations
Users wanting something ultra-compact or low-profile
reviews.author: Ricki Pickle

reviews.title: Works great!
reviews.comment: My PC came with one of those cheap wi-fi dongles, no speed at all, and barely one bar of signal showing.  Bought this adapter from Nineplus and it is awesome! Simple install and works great. I've got full signal strength and plenty of speed.  They have a great warranty as well.

reviews.comment: does the job! the wifi whatever thing in my laptop stopped working & didn’t wanna pay $100 to replace the part. my wifi still runs fast when using this! its a bit bulky & flimsy which can get annoying if you use your laptop anywhere but a table. however, it fixed my problem and all is well. also super easy to use, i just connected it, logged into my wifi and i was set
reviews.author: kate

reviews.title: Easy to set up- and WORKS!
reviews.comment:
I was fully convinced my PC just was not good. It struggled with connecting to the internet every day, and would randomly cut out. Ever since I got this adapter- it hasn't cut out ONCE other than when the actual internet is down. I plugged it in, and that was it- and it's worked ever since!
The only downside is the size, and orientation of the usb. My USBs are vertical, so plugging this in pretty much takes up any nearby slots. However, its compatibility with my computer, AND the additional range it gives me makes up for it. Super happy with this purchase!
reviews.author: Mr. Moon

reviews.title: Need to download drivers for older computers
reviews.comment: I bought this for a computer that has Window 7, but after plugging it in, it didn't work, so I had to download drivers. But how to you download drivers on a computer that has no internet?? I used a newer computer and a flash drive to download the drivers and then upload to the old computer and then it worked! Many steps, but it ultimately worked, so I am happy with the product
